newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall after initial rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall after initial rise.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell on Monday after an initial rise and dealers attributed the trend to market manipulation by some operators.
"Some major bull operators in the producing centres have formed a cartel which is dragging prices upward ahead of new crop arrivals," one dealer said.
Castorseed December delivery fell to 1,094 rupees from 1,098 and 1,084. March delivery was quoted at 1,140 rupees but trading was nominal and focus remained on December delivery.
Groundnut oil slid to 347 rupees from 350 on sluggish demand. Rajkot spot oil rose to 535 rupees from 525 rupees.
